The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Cites the Consumer Guarantees Act 1993 acceptable quality guarantee (s 6/s 7) and the consumer's redress options (s 18, s 23)
- Flags that a blanket no-refunds policy cannot override these guarantees for a consumer transaction
- Explains when contracting out might apply only for business-use purchases under s 43(2)
